title: Classic British Bubble and Squeak
description: A traditional British dish made from leftover potatoes and cabbage, pan-fried to a crispy golden brown. Perfect for using up leftover roast dinner ingredients.

ingredients.name: Leftover roast potatoes
ingredients.notes: Diced or mashed, whichever you have

ingredients.name: Cabbage
ingredients.notes: Chopped, leftover from a roast dinner

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of butter in a large non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the chopped cabbage and cook until it starts to wilt, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the leftover roast potatoes and stir to combine with the onion and cabbage.
Use a spatula to press the mixture down into the pan, creating a flat surface.
Continue cooking for a further 3-4 minutes, until the bottom is golden brown.
Use the spatula to carefully lift and flip the bubble and squeak over.
Cook for a further 2-3 minutes, until the other side is also golden brown.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
